title: Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS): A Formal Mathematical Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.08778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) operates on document pairs, returning a single scalar per comparison. In a multi-document setting where several sources may have contributed to one or more targets, pairwise STS cannot disentangle each source's marginal semantic contribution from their shared vocabulary. In this paper, Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS) is introduced as a conditional form of STS that computes similarity between two documents after eliminating semantic elements shared with a third via set-theoretic operations. SCS makes four contributions: 1) it introduces directionality, partitioning pairwise relations into lateral (inter-source) and vertical (source-to-target) classes; 2) conditioning induces role-dependent asymmetry by extending the comparison domain from unordered pairs to ordered, conditioned triples of a target, a reference, and a conditioning document; 3) SCS introduces inter-document conditioning by subtracting

translated_title: 语义条件相似度（SCS）：一个形式化数学框架
translated_abstract: 语义文本相似度（STS）作用于文档对，每次比较返回一个单一的标量。在多文档场景中，当多个源文档可能对一个或多个目标文档有所贡献时，成对STS无法将每个源文档的边际语义贡献从它们共享的词汇中分离出来。本文引入语义条件相似度（SCS）作为STS的一种条件形式，它通过集合论运算，在消除与第三个文档共享的语义元素之后计算两个文档之间的相似度。SCS做出了四项贡献：1）它引入了方向性，将成对关系划分为横向（源与源之间）和纵向（源到目标）两类；2）条件化通过将比较域从无序对扩展到有序的、带条件的三元组（目标文档、参考文档和条件文档），诱导出依赖于角色的不对称性；3）SCS通过减法运算引入了文档间条件化……
tldr: 本文提出语义条件相似度（SCS）这一形式化数学框架，通过集合论运算在消除与第三方文档共享的语义元素后计算文档相似度，为多文档场景引入方向性、角色不对称性及文档间条件化机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS), a formal mathematical framework that computes document similarity after eliminating semantic elements shared with a third document via set-theoretic operations, introducing directionality, role-dependent asymmetry, and inter-document conditioning for multi-document scenarios.
